findings.text: the plan says "The bad row's `node_definition.write_paths` names only the legacy path, and the full head `0a451acf…` appears nowhere on the row", but nova's `docs/state/nova/runs/r-20261018T192200408612-review-of-tcv-liuqe-known-answer-0a451acfdb02.json` at commit `e99d2b385` declares both write paths, the second being `…/review-records/r-20261018T134957600545-tcv-liuqe-known-answer.at-0a451acfdb02d4b05a5d8f77c7a711943f0d4cce.json`, so the full head is on the row and `_review_subject` (which reads a head from a declared `.at-` write path) recovers it without the node-id suffix — meaning §1's first deliverable bullet, and its done-when item that requires every minting path to record the head, rest on a premise this row refutes
